# Quest shell Application factory

This source-only dependency is the unchanged public shell Application factory
from the exact Rusty Quest commit/tree and two-file source/license inventory in
`UPSTREAM.json`. Rusty Quest owns its genuine process UID/eUID, installed shell
package, Application/context/attribution and AppOps admission checks. Do not
edit vendored bytes; update the upstream owner and exact inventory deliberately.

The optional Kiosk shell companion compiles this source with its own fixed
Navigator protocol. The main APK, setup helper and Launcher Lite do not compile
or initialize it. The factory accepts no operation/target and grants no
permission; Kiosk independently checks its fixed API and owns guard policy,
original callbacks and helper retirement. This adds no recenter action to the
Navigator companion. Existing recenter utility pins remain separate.
